title: Line trails
description: Generative line art that draws itself: many curves (spiral arms, a precessing orbit rosette, Lissajous ribbons or rose petals) traced by bright heads with fading comet tails, leaving a fine line behind so the figure builds up. Heads accelerate out and settle; tails stretch with speed. Opaque by default, for an editorial interlude, a background behind a numeral or title, or a transition texture.

pattern.description: spiral: arms winding out from the centre; orbit: an ellipse precessing into a rosette; lissajous: a ribbon of crossing figure loops filling the frame; rose: petal loops.

turns.description: Density of each figure: spiral and orbit turns, Lissajous frequency, rose petals.

tail.description: Comet tail length at full speed, as a fraction of each line.

trace.description: Leave a fine line where each head has been, so the figure builds up.

heads.description: A bright dot at the head of each line.

width.description: Line width at the head, px at 1080.

colors.description: Line colours as #rrggbb, cycling (empty: ink, with every fourth line in the accent).

size.description: Figure size relative to the safe area (above 1 runs past it, for a background).
